From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly MAP sync: cloud channel buyflow & marketplace onboarding

Hi team —

Following up with this week’s MAP checkpoint for the CloudReseller buyflow & marketplace path. Purpose: align on remaining dependencies for AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listings and reseller coordination so we can hit the target SLA in our mutual action plan (close target: 2027-05-10).

Summary (top-line):
- Marketplace listing: CloudReseller to start AWS procurement paper trail (SOW, billing PID) — blocker for AWS listing submission.
- Reseller contract: legal redline review in progress (CloudReseller / Redwood).
- Test plan: shared evaluation dataset and perf acceptance criteria drafted (attached MAP_v1).

This week’s asks / owners:
1) CloudReseller: share final procurement contact + billing PO (owner: procurement@cloudreseller.com) — ETA 2027-04-09.
2) Vanessa (partnerships): confirm reseller SKU mapping for marketplace listing (owner: vanessa_ortiz) — ETA 2027-04-08.
3) Lauren (sales ops): push HubSpot deal to stage 'Marketplace Ready' and attach signed MAP (owner: lauren_bishop) — ETA 2027-04-12.
4) Rishi (solutions): finalize the evaluation test harness and send baseline run results (owner: rishi_malhotra) — ETA 2027-04-11.
5) Technical: Sergio to confirm runtime compatibility matrix for 4/8 customer sequences (owner: sergio_alvarez) — ETA 2027-04-10.

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan draft), procurement-checklist.pdf (procurement items we typically need for AWS/GCP listings).

Proposed sync: quick 20-min checkpoint on 2027-04-08 09:30 PT to validate progress and unblock legal if needed. If that works for external stakeholders, I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Karthik + team,

Thanks — received and reviewed the MAP draft. A couple quick notes from our side:

- Procurement: we can provide the billing PO by 2027-04-09 as requested. Point of contact will be Maria Chen (maria.chen@cloudreseller.com).
- Legal: redlines to the reseller addendum will be routed today; expect initial comments by EOD 2027-04-06.
- AWS listing: we need the SKU mapping and a brief product summary (100–150 words) for the AWS Marketplace listing form. We can start the listing once those are provided.

We can make the 04/08 09:30 PT slot for a 20-min sync. Please send an invite.

Quick ask: can Redwood confirm the acceptance test threshold for latency (p95) and token throughput so we can align the internal QA?

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Partner Success, CloudReseller Inc.

Thanks Rafael — great to hear. Quick answers inline and a couple commits: 

- Acceptance thresholds (short answer): p95 inference latency <= 350ms (seq length 512, batch=1) and sustained token throughput >= 1.5k tokens/s for the evaluation harness. We’ll provide the exact perf run artifact (JSON) after Rishi’s baseline run.
- SKU mapping: Vanessa will own creating a 1-page SKU map and the 100–150 word marketplace summary; ETA 2027-04-08.
- Legal: Lauren — please watch for CloudReseller redlines and coordinate one follow-up call with legal if needed.

Action items (updated):
A1) Maria Chen (CloudReseller) to share billing PO — ETA 2027-04-09 — owner: CloudReseller procurement.
A2) Vanessa to deliver SKU map + 150-word summary — ETA 2027-04-08 — owner: vanessa_ortiz.
A3) Rishi to run baseline evaluation on sample dataset and share perf artifact — ETA 2027-04-11 — owner: rishi_malhotra.
A4) Sergio to validate runtime compatibility with marketplace packaging (container/AMI) and confirm any missing libs — ETA 2027-04-10 — owner: sergio_alvarez.
A5) Lauren to attach signed MAP and move HubSpot deal to 'Marketplace Ready' once procurement PO received — ETA 2027-04-12 — owner: lauren_bishop.

I will send the calendar invite for 04/08 09:30 PT. If anything slips, mention it on the invite thread and we’ll triage.

Cheers,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
